summary: Iteration 19 verification — all 3 bug fixes pass. Backend: 10/10 pytest (5 new ledger-enhanced tests for ACC000011 + 5 iter-18 regression). Frontend: 4/4 UI checks (Add Receive Amount rename in trigger button, ledger Interest Breakdown shows FIFO and MANUAL badges with correct per-entry I+P values, mobile layout shows no horizontal overflow with Edit button fully visible).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/accounts.py is now 992 lines — at the upper limit; the get_enhanced_ledger function is ~280 lines and still duplicates chronological replay logic that is also present in services/financial.process_payment. Recommend extracting the per-payment-row 'apply allocation OR fallback to sequential FIFO walk' block into services/financial so the legacy fallback never drifts from the live algorithm.

The legacy-FIFO fallback in get_enhanced_ledger (lines 791-821) is dead code as long as the iter-18 migration ran for all rows — consider logging a warning when it triggers so unmigrated rows surface quickly.
AccountDetailPage.js is now ~1135 lines; ledger table row + expanded transaction-detail panel is a strong candidate to extract into <LedgerTable /> + <LedgerRowDetail />.
Manual allocation rounding tolerance of 0.01 is still in place; ok for now but consider centralizing with a shared MONEY_EPSILON constant.
